sentences.text:
Mr M. J. Khan, Addl. P. P. for the Non-Applicant No.1/
 CORAM : VINAY JOSHI AND VALMIKI SA MENEZES, JJ.

This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report (FIR) in Crime No.491 of 2020, registered with Awadhutwadi Police Station, District Yavatmal, for the offence punishable under Sections 498A and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. The Applicants are husband and nearer relatives of husband of informant lady.
It is submitted that the allegations levelled against the Applicants are omnibus and vague.
It is submitted that Applicant Nos.4 to 7 are married sisters of husband, who are staying elsewhere, but have been falsely implicated in the case.
4. Issue notice for final disposal, returnable after four weeks.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives notice on behalf of Non- Applicant No.1/State.
5.
In the meantime, the Trial Court shall not insist for the presence of Applicant Nos.2 to 7 except on the date of framing of charge.

(VALMIKI SA MENEZES, J.) 
Digitally Signed By:ASHISH ASHOKRAO TAMBE Rupesh Naraynrao Bobde And 6 Others vs State Of Mha.
